name: HireArt
tagline: All‑in‑one platform to hire, manage, and pay contract W2 workers, freelancers, and staffing vendors.
description: HireArt provides a single platform for employer of record, on‑demand sourcing, vendor management, and freelancer management. It enables businesses to hire, classify, and manage contract W2 employees and 1099 freelancers while ensuring compliance. The solution includes software, services, and expert guidance to reduce costs and improve workforce visibility.

name: Amplitude
tagline: AI‑powered product analytics platform for smarter decisions
description: Amplitude provides product analytics, AI‑driven feedback, session replay, and feature experimentation to help teams understand customer behavior. It offers a free tier with up to 2 million events per month and scales for enterprise use. Trusted by thousands of customers across many industries.

name: HackerRank
tagline: Online Coding Tests and Technical Interviews
description: HackerRank provides market‑leading coding tests and interview solutions for hiring developers. It offers AI‑enhanced screening and pair‑programming interview products used by thousands of companies and millions of developers.

name: OneSignal
tagline: Omni-channel messaging platform for push, email, SMS, and in-app notifications with AI-driven lifecycle automation.
description: OneSignal delivers mobile push, web push, SMS, email, and in‑app messaging for over 2 million businesses, handling more than 12 billion messages annually. The platform includes AI‑powered lifecycle marketing to onboard, engage, and retain users. SDKs are available for Android, iOS, Flutter, React Native, Expo, and Unity for fast integration.

name: Streak
description: Streak embeds a full CRM directly inside Gmail, letting users manage pipelines and log emails without leaving their inbox. It offers AI‑driven data entry, automated logging, and custom visualizations to keep deals up to date.
